items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Filter chips that join like blocks, and input chips with smooth removal. Civilian Studios — Default kit.

items.name: metallic
items.title: Metallic UI
items.description: A metal skin for shadcn: brushed steel and eleven other alloys, with dials for polish, finish, grain, depth, density, corners, motion and sweep. Turn it on with data-material="metallic" and mount MetallicRuntime once. Civilian Studios — Metallic kit.
items.docs: Add data-material="metallic" (and any dials) to your <html> tag, then render <MetallicRuntime /> once in your root layout. Pick your dials at https://civilian.studio/metallic/ui

items.name: metallic-chip
items.title: Metallic Chip
items.description: Chip in brushed steel: chips snap flush like machined parts, with one light sweep when they turn on. Civilian Studios — Metallic kit.

items.name: metallic-button
items.title: Metallic Button
items.description: Button in brushed steel. Civilian Studios — Metallic kit.

items.name: dot-object
items.title: Dot Object
items.description: A 3D object drawn as dots, with idle, thinking, working, success, error and lost states for AI products. Takes a model (install dot-object-dragon or dot-object-brain, or use the built-in spheres), a required label that screen readers hear on every state change, and an optional shimmering text label. Civilian Studios — Default kit.

items.name: dot-object-dragon
items.title: Dot Object: Dragon
items.description: Winged dragon model (7000 dots) for Dot Object. Winged Dragon, one of pair, Minneapolis Institute of Art, CC0.

items.name: dot-object-brain
items.title: Dot Object: Brain
items.description: Brain model (5000 dots) for Dot Object. Brain by J-Toastie via Poly Pizza, licensed CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/): keep this credit wherever it ships.

items.name: slime-switch
items.title: Slime Switch
items.description: Radix switch with a persistent liquid surface, four palettes, optional state text, accessible label layouts, reduced motion and dried disabled state. Civilian Studios — Slime kit.
